title: Patroni: graceful replica leave
description: Runs `nexus scale-out remove postgres pg-replica-2`: stops nexus-patroni so the node leaves the cluster gracefully (refuses the current leader).

observe.what: pg-replica-2 leaves (service stopped); ready for re-add

observe.where: patronictl list on a surviving node

whatProves: PatroniAdapter.ScaleOutRemoveAsync gracefully removes a replica and refuses removing the current Patroni leader.
